owner: Sanitized archive qualification developer through review, repository maintainers after handoff
retention: Bounded release evidence until superseded by matching qualification or feature retirement. No raw fixtures, routine logs, browser profiles or traces retained.

inputs.runtime: Windows 10.0.26200.0 x64, Node 24.15.0, persistent normal Chromium HeadlessChrome/151.0.7922.34, real isolated PostgreSQL 18.2 and loopback HTTP.

method.build: stack build hmem-server:exe:hmem-test-harness and frontend node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build with local node_modules/.bin on PATH
method.matrix: From repository root with HMEM_ARCHIVE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS and HMEM_ARCHIVE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256 bound to the matching executable, node hmem-server/frontend/tests-js/support/run-sanitized-archive-qualification.mjs <mode>. Three serial vectors, no concurrent build or diagnostic allocator capture.
method.measurements: Application WorkingSetSize and browser total private_footprint_bytes are sampled over their corresponding active or idle baselines. PostgreSQL is separate. Sampling does not measure an unsampled continuous peak.
scope_limits: Loopback native integration with observed compressed EOF, worker handoff, verified rows and navigation. Prior controlled 100 Mbit/s transfer, 250 ms loading acknowledgement and 20-action navigation p95 are separate coverage.
1 MiB measures browser JSONL export and sanitized ZIP. Larger vectors exercise full gzip/views and streamed ZIP where completed. Larger Home navigation measures bounded backward progress.
The 1 MiB storage sample has 256 distinct deterministic base64 strings and 768 unchanged rows. Larger stress fixtures have one repeated opaque payload at the same density. No corpus savings estimate.

Storage reports logical rows/bytes, stored value bytes and allocated heap/TOAST/index totals; retained WAL segment size is an allocation, not bytes written. This does not establish sanitized vacuum/reuse or restored sanitized generation behavior.
The GiB runs ended before the full application-memory assertion and complete two-view browser matrix, so the GiB server gate remains unqualified.
Successful reclaim-and-compatibility time includes checks and ZIP after delete completion. It is not the time to delete rows.

diagnostic_repeat.purpose: Repeat GiB with the same product bundle and unchanged acceptance deadlines. Record exact maintenance state if the 90 s gate expires and delimit sampled browser peaks against existing events.

reclamation.status: observed complete under the 90 s gate
reclamation.reason: The repeat reached a fresh verified-generation request after the synchronous complete cleanup, zero original rows, original-only rejection and full verified ZIP assertions.
reclamation.unavailable: Successful phase timings were not emitted because the diagnostic only samples generation and occurrence state at a missed 90 s boundary. The first run's timeout cannot be attributed to independent verification, occurrence or delete batches from these runs.

browser.attribution: The first index/handoff peak sample ended before first processor-ready, so that sample occurred during processing before detach and reader adoption. The highest sample occurred during the fresh view before verification. Process totals cannot identify an allocation source.

failures.measurement: The 16 MiB bounded CDP trace read failed closed after both above-cap samples were already observed. The sampled increment is a lower bound on the peak.
failures.cleanup: First actual persistent browser close timed out. Same supervisor stdin status id 100 and close id 101 reached the exact retained owner. The failed test exit was preserved.
